glosses: unfortunately, regrettably, sadly, woefully, regretfully, unluckily, lamentably, alas, disappointingly, tragically

examples.text: Lamentablemente, mi madre no está en casa.
examples.en: Unfortunately, my mother isn't at home.

examples.text: Lamentablemente, él se rehusó a venir.

examples.en: Unfortunately, I don't share your views.

examples.text: Lamentablemente, ella vive en el extranjero.
Lamentablemente, será imposible para nosotros aceptar tu propuesta.
examples.en: Unfortunately it will be impossible for us to accept your proposal.
